purpose: Define descriptive annotations, tags, labels, owners/stewards, glossary refs and documentation as explicit metadata records bound to exact target identities without becoming semantic truth by annotation alone.

topics.name: DWH Metadata Annotation
topics.purpose: Define descriptive annotations, tags, labels, owners/stewards, glossary refs and documentation as explicit metadata records bound to exact target identities without becoming semantic truth by annotation alone.

semantics.annotation_rule: Each machine-significant annotation has an explicit identity or explicit target+key/value record identity according to profile.
semantics.source_rule: Annotation source/author/provenance is explicit where relevant.
semantics.truth_rule: Human-authored metadata is descriptive evidence and never canonical domain truth merely by presence.
semantics.conflict_rule: Conflicting annotations coexist/reconcile explicitly rather than newest-wins by timestamp.
semantics.localization_rule: Human-facing labels/descriptions may use localization refs without changing internal identifiers.
semantics.authority_rule: Metadata authorship/ownership label does not automatically create AccessCore rights.

invariants.rule: Catalog and metadata records describe exact DWH resources and evidence; discovery, labels, annotations, ranking or catalog visibility never replace canonical resource identity, semantic ownership, classification policy or authorization.

hard_gates.condition: annotation label replaces canonical field identity
latest annotation silently overwrites conflicting meaning

references.purpose: Human-facing metadata can use localized labels/context.
